How to do a water change🫧  This was the first water change after my betta moved in last week.  Step 1: unplug the heater, light, filter Step 2: siphon the substrate/ground Step 3: drain approx. 1/3 of the water  Step 4: dechlorinate the fresh water and fill up the aquarium Step 5: wipe the rim, edges, outside of the tank Step 6: feed your betta and show them some love. I made a pretty serious mistake while cleaning out one of my reef tanks, and I wanted to share what happened. I think we need to get better about talking about our mistakes in this hobby. It’s easy to share the beautiful tanks, thriving corals, and things we’re doing right. It’s a lot harder to admit when we screw something up, especially knowing how judgmental people can be. But there’s a lot to be learned from other people’s mistakes, and sometimes those lessons are far more important than anything we learn from their successes. I’m not sharing this because I want sympathy or because I’m proud of what happened. I’m sharing it because I hope someone else can learn from it and avoid putting themselves or their family in danger. We all make mistakes. We should be able to talk about them without being afraid of getting torn apart for it. Hopefully my mistake can keep someone else from making the same one. #fishtok #reeftank #saltwater #aquarium #cleaning
